remarks: A desirable location near Downtown Stamford, this 2BD condo with stunning views of the city of Stamford is fully updated, freshly painted and ready for you. The fully remodeled kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances is opened into the living room with access to the balcony with amazing city views from all rooms. Very well maintained building with newer roof, new elevators. The landlord pays for the heat and hot water up to 55F, tenant is responsible for anything over 55F. This condo offers convenience, comfort and appeal. One assigned parking spot is included in rent. Common laundry on premises. Walk to downtown Stamford, minutes to train, beaches, shops and restaurants. Good credit is a MUST. Do not wait, this one will not last long!
